candidates.title: Delete a post
candidates.snippet: Deleting a post removes it from the community for everyone. Use the author delete action.

candidates.title: Local post indexing
candidates.snippet: The indexer stores a local database of public posts for search.

candidates.title: Hide a post locally
candidates.snippet: Hide this post on your current device. It remains visible to other people and is not deleted.

candidates.snippet: Upload an image and enter a title to publish a new post.

candidates.snippet: The post has been published and is visible in the community.

candidates.title: Post waiting for publication

candidates.title: Publication history
candidates.snippet: The profile lists older posts and their publication dates.

candidates.title: Evaluator instruction

candidates.title: Export private key
candidates.snippet: Export your private signing key to back up your ability to control the account. Keep it secret.

candidates.title: Export public key
candidates.snippet: Copy or export the public key to share the identifier for your account.

candidates.title: Understanding keys
candidates.snippet: Public keys identify accounts; private keys authorize account actions.

candidates.title: Display settings
